description: On-chain blockchain data for AI agents. 41 MCP tools for whale tracking, entity analysis, exchange flows, ML predictions, wallet profiling, direct Ethereum RPC, and cross-chain signals across Ethereum, Bitcoin, and Hyperliquid.

findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.
